gate_changes_reviewed: No new scientific threshold or doctrine change was observed.

After a rolling 3/3 MECHANISM SUB window, a prospectively typed high-information SYSTEM reproducibility object was selected, demonstrating that one-in-three remains a minimum floor rather than a mechanism-share target.
Fresh SYSTEM object fixed claim_ceiling=SYSTEM, comparator, supported spacing, observables and terminal map before outcome and remained SYSTEM after a clean negative/reduction terminal.
Classification completeness increased from 9/9 to 10/10 without funnel conversion rates being promoted into scientific thresholds.

Fresh MAIN consumed the new Analyst generation and remained intentionally idle with system_priority_exception.used=false; the newest SYSTEM work was SUB Discovery, so the first MAIN SYSTEM-priority exception remains untested.
false_positive_risks: A bounded SYSTEM negative such as ORDER_INVARIANT_AT_SUPPORTED_SPACING could be overgeneralized into a global order-invariance theorem; current Analyst explicitly restricts scope to one deterministic DEV seed/condition/supported spacing and requires fresh objects for broader questions.
A future SYSTEM priority exception could still be rationalized post hoc unless persisted before MAIN execution; no actual exception has yet been used.
Small-N funnel conversion counts could be overinterpreted even at 10/10 classification completeness; current Analyst keeps them descriptive only.
The rolling mechanism fraction could become a prestige score in either direction; current 3/3-to-2/3 transition correctly demonstrates that no preferred ratio should be inferred.
false_negative_risks: A future READY checklist could become a hidden second Formal gate if comparator/reduction/falsifier are interpreted as already won; no READY case exists yet.

MECHANISM priority could suppress testbed/reproducibility work if SYSTEM value is treated as second-class; the fresh evaluation-order selection is counterevidence and should remain the model behavior.
A 2/3 or 3/3 rolling mechanism fraction must not become an allocation target that crowds out higher-information SYSTEM work.
Repeated bounded negative results must remain object-local and not be generalized into topic-family no-go conclusions.

No READY candidate or Analyst-authoritative READY-to-PRE_FORMAL transition exists yet; that remains the highest-information unresolved calibration event.

claim_type_separation_findings: Healthy. The fresh evaluation-order question was prospectively SYSTEM/testbed/reproducibility and remained SYSTEM after a negative reduction; it received no mechanism novelty credit. Prior rejected MECHANISM objects were not rescued into SYSTEM, while independently valuable SYSTEM work remains selectable when information gain justifies it.

mechanism_supply_health.finding: The latest autonomous selection deliberately chose a coherent SYSTEM reproducibility/testbed question after the mechanism floor had already been exceeded. This is direct evidence that one-in-three is a minimum quality-controlled supply floor rather than a target, and that SYSTEM value is not being suppressed.

funnel_observability.finding: All material current candidates have mandatory v2.1 fields. The newest SYSTEM object has prospective/current-object ceiling, preformal status, terminal and queue state visible through closure. Funnel metrics remain descriptive small-N statistics rather than thresholds.

preformal_gate_calibration.finding: No new READY evidence exists. The existing prospective MECHANISM examples continue to show eligibility without readiness or prior scientific success. The first Analyst-authoritative READY-to-PRE_FORMAL transition remains untested.

system_priority_exception_audit.finding: The fresh SYSTEM evaluation-order object was autonomous SUB Discovery after the mechanism supply floor was already satisfied. Fresh MAIN remained idle and did not run SYSTEM ahead of a comparable MECHANISM. The first real prospective MAIN system_priority_exception remains insufficient evidence.

no_coherent_target_audit.finding: No NO_COHERENT_MECHANISM_TARGET escape-hatch use is observed. The rolling window remains above the supply floor without invoking the exception; calibration of its first actual use remains insufficient evidence.

classification_completeness.policy_use: Conversion and disposition rates may be described for this fully classified current population but remain small-N descriptive statistics, not scientific, readiness or allocation thresholds.

prospective_recommendations: Keep Funnel v2.1 scientific gates unchanged and do not add universal numeric support/readiness thresholds.

Treat one-in-three theory-backward supply strictly as a minimum quality-controlled floor; with the current 2/3 window, subsequent SUB selection should still maximize expected information gain rather than target a mechanism ratio.
Preserve genuinely high-value SYSTEM work for testbed validity, evidence interpretation, reachability, reproducibility and Formal integrity when independently justified.
Keep SYSTEM conclusions object-local; any broader or different-spacing evaluation-order question must be a fresh prospectively typed object, not cycle-2 rescue.
Audit the first actual MAIN system_priority_exception, first NO_COHERENT_MECHANISM_TARGET use, and first Analyst-authoritative READY-to-PRE_FORMAL transition.
Continue gating funnel-rate policy conclusions on classification completeness and small-N interpretation.
